objects.description: During the [2016 Ukraine Electric Power Attack](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0025), [Sandworm Team](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0034) used a trojanized version of Windows Notepad to add a layer of persistence for [Industroyer](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0604).(Citation: ESET Industroyer)
objects.description_fa: در [https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0025 https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0025، https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0025)، https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0034 از نسخه تروجانیزه‌شده‌ی Notepad Windows برای افزودن لایه‌ای از ماندگاری برای [Industroyer]([[[CTI_PRESERVE_]0][CTI_PRESERVE_0] استفاده کرد. (Citation: ESET Industroyer) https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0604
